game_title: Code Reading Relay – Sandstorm Pass Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round, scarab swarms strike the sundial, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sundial from scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass: keep the predicted meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: predicted drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
